title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #7

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Falaq have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. Which surah speaks about Abu Lahab? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Masad

3. Which best describes trustworthiness? (1 mark)
   A. Being the tallest
   B. Speaking loudly
   C. Winning every game
   D. Keeping promises and returning what you borrow

4. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do to solve the dispute about placing the Black Stone? (1 mark)
   A. Threw it away
   B. Asked one tribe alone to place it
   C. Kept it for himself
   D. Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together

5. A friend gives you back too much change by mistake. What would a person of the Prophet's character do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others to do the same
   B. Return the extra money
   C. Spend it on sweets
   D. Keep it quietly

6. What is the Prophet's way of life called? (1 mark)
   A. The Hajj
   B. The Qibla
   C. The Zakat
   D. The Sunnah

7. Which time is most important for a child to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Before going to bed
   B. Only after a visit to the dentist
   C. Only on Sunday
   D. Only after playing

8. What is oral hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   B. Cleaning the room
   C. Washing feet
   D. Cleaning clothes

9. What should we do to use Allah's names in dua? (1 mark)
   A. Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   B. Stay silent
   C. Shout
   D. Call on other beings

10. What does "As-Salam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The Most Merciful
   C. The All-Hearing
   D. The Source of Peace

11. Ar-Rahman's mercy is (1 mark)
   A. Only for the rich
   B. For all creation
   C. Only for adults
   D. Only for Muslims in Kenya

12. What does "As-Sami'" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Seeing
   B. The Most Kind
   C. The All-Hearing
   D. The King

13. Which pillar of Iman are we practising when we say "I believe in the angels"? (1 mark)
   A. Belief in the Last Day
   B. Belief in Allah's angels
   C. Belief in destiny
   D. Belief in the books

14. Why do Muslims believe in all the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   B. They are all angels
   C. They all lived in Makkah
   D. They were all kings

15. What did the Prophet say about purity? (1 mark)
   A. It is half of faith
   B. It is a game
   C. It is not important
   D. It is only for adults

16. What should you do after cleaning a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore
   B. Sleep
   C. Wash your hands
   D. Eat immediately

17. What do we recite after wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. The testimony of faith
   B. Nothing
   C. A song
   D. Surah Al-Masad

18. What does the Prophet say about wudhu on the Day of Judgement? (1 mark)
   A. Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   B. Nothing
   C. Only rich people will shine
   D. Wudhu will be forgotten

19. What is the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A call to prayer
   B. A prayer mat
   C. The direction of the Kaaba
   D. A garment

20. What is tartib? (1 mark)
   A. Doing the pillars in order
   B. Praying without wudhu
   C. Praying fast
   D. Making dua

21. Which is a condition and not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Fatiha
   B. Taslim
   C. Sujud
   D. Covering the awrah

22. What should you do before putting a load on a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore its health
   B. Add extra sacks
   C. Make sure it is not too heavy
   D. Hit it

23. Kindness to animals is (1 mark)
   A. A waste
   B. Only for farmers
   C. An act of worship when done for Allah
   D. Forbidden

24. The Prophet said those who show mercy will be shown mercy by (1 mark)
   A. The government
   B. The teacher
   C. The Most Merciful
   D. A friend

25. What does haya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Modesty
   B. Anger
   C. Pride
   D. Speed

26. Why should you tell a parent if something online makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. They will laugh
   C. It wastes their time
   D. They can protect you

27. Which of these should you never share with strangers? (1 mark)
   A. The weather
   B. Your passwords
   C. Your favourite colour
   D. Your favourite food

28. Which verse tells us to greet when entering homes? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 112:1
   B. Qur'an 1:2
   C. Qur'an 24:61
   D. Qur'an 110:1

29. When you enter your home after school, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   B. Slam the door
   C. Sleep
   D. Shout

30. What does the dua for leaving the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the name of Allah we enter
   B. In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   C. Allah is the Greatest
   D. Glory to my Lord

31. What is muamalat? (1 mark)
   A. A journey
   B. The way people deal with each other
   C. A fast
   D. A prayer

32. What does spending on family for Allah's pleasure count as? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. A sin
   C. Waste
   D. Charity

33. What is the dua for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   D. Subhanallah

34. What should a child do to a cousin who has more toys? (1 mark)
   A. Be happy for them, not envy
   B. Envy them
   C. Break them
   D. Take them

35. Which action helps keep family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding
   B. Visiting relatives
   C. Envy
   D. Gossiping

36. Why do we respect older relatives? (1 mark)
   A. They are rich
   B. They are strong
   C. They are noisy
   D. They have experience and wisdom

37. How can you keep in touch with a relative far away? (1 mark)
   A. Call, send a message or a gift
   B. Forget
   C. Ignore
   D. Insult

38. What is the Night of the first revelation often connected with? (1 mark)
   A. Laylat al-Qadr
   B. Hajj
   C. Eid
   D. Mawlid

39. In which month did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Ramadan
   B. Rajab
   C. Shawwal
   D. Muharram

40. What does "As-Siddiq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fast one
   B. The old one
   C. The truthful one who believes
   D. The rich one

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give three positive uses of media. (3 marks)

42. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

43. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

44. Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision. (3 marks)

45. Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik. (3 marks)

46. Define wudhu and state its intention. (2 marks)

47. Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an. (5 marks)

48. Explain why we say Bismillah before eating. (3 marks)

49. Give two items used in purification of najasaat. (2 marks)

50. Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam. (4 marks)

51. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations? (3 marks)

52. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)

53. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)

54. Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions. (5 marks)

55. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)

56. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

57. Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain. (4 marks)

58. State two reasons why we wear clothes. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 5
   Al-Falaq has five verses.

2. D — Al-Masad
   Al-Masad warns Abu Lahab, whose wealth did not save him.

3. D — Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   A trustworthy person can be relied on.

4. D — Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together
   The cloak let every tribe share in the honour.

5. B — Return the extra money
   Honesty means returning what is not yours.

6. D — The Sunnah
   Sunnah means the way of the Prophet.

7. A — Before going to bed
   Less saliva flows during sleep.

8. A — Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   Oral means mouth.

9. A — Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   Allah told us to call on Him by His names.

10. D — The Source of Peace
   As-Salam is free of all faults and gives peace.

11. B — For all creation
   It covers believers and non-believers, people and animals.

12. C — The All-Hearing
   As-Sami' hears everything.

13. B — Belief in Allah's angels
   It is the second pillar of Iman.

14. A — They were all sent by Allah with the same basic message
   Islam makes no difference in belief.

15. A — It is half of faith
   Recorded by Muslim.

16. C — Wash your hands
   Wash hands with soap and water.

17. A — The testimony of faith
   Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah...

18. A — Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   Recorded by Muslim.

19. C — The direction of the Kaaba
   Muslims face the Kaaba.

20. A — Doing the pillars in order
   It means order.

21. D — Covering the awrah
   It is met before the prayer starts.

22. C — Make sure it is not too heavy
   Do not overload an animal.

23. C — An act of worship when done for Allah
   Mercy pleases Allah.

24. C — The Most Merciful
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

25. A — Modesty
   Haya is modesty or shyness from wrong.

26. D — They can protect you
   Adults can help.

27. B — Your passwords
   Passwords keep you safe.

28. C — Qur'an 24:61
   Surah An-Nur 24:61.

29. A — Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   Say dua and greet.

30. B — In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   That is the meaning.

31. B — The way people deal with each other
   Muamalat covers social relations.

32. D — Charity
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

33. C — Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
   A dua asking mercy for parents.

34. A — Be happy for them, not envy
   Do not envy.

35. B — Visiting relatives
   Visits strengthen bonds.

36. D — They have experience and wisdom
   Elders deserve respect.

37. A — Call, send a message or a gift
   Keep contact.

38. A — Laylat al-Qadr
   Surah 97 speaks about it.

39. A — Ramadan
   The Qur'an began in Ramadan.

40. C — The truthful one who believes
   Abu Bakr's title.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four roles.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.

56. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
